name: bullix-webos
description: Bullix TV client for LG webOS (HTML5 + vanilla JS)

scripts.serve: npm run build && npx playwright install chromium && node scripts/dev-server.mjs
scripts.serve:chrome: npm run build && node scripts/dev-server.mjs & sleep 1 && open -na 'Google Chrome' --args --disable-web-security --user-data-dir=/tmp/idlix-chrome-dev http://127.0.0.1:5173
scripts.package: npm run build && npx ares-package dist ./service/com.idlix.tv.webos.proxy -o .
